Criterion: Students attempt before any method is modeled
What pass requires: The anchor problem is posed without a solution method, and 스스로 해결하기 comes before any teacher demonstration of a strategy or algorithm; the formal term or procedure is named only in 정리하기. Pass = students' own attempts precede modeling. Fail = the teacher models the method in 문제 만나기 and students imitate it.
Notes: Replaces upstream P-M1 (IM curriculum signal). The Korean port has no curriculum branching; the invariant it keeps is the problem-first arc. Source: math.md 핵심 교수 원리, 수업 흐름.

Criterion: Anticipated responses name the wrong form
What pass requires: At least 2 of the 2–3 anticipated student responses state a specific wrong equation or answer next to the correct one (e.g. '1/3 < 1/5이라고 쓴다', '403−158=355'), not a general confusion ('분수 개념이 부족하다'). Any wrong answer quoted must be the one the stated error actually produces.
Notes: Carried from upstream P-M2 with Korean examples. Source: math.md 섹션 구조 5.

Criterion: 풀이 나누기 is at least 10 minutes with a student-to-student talk move
What pass requires: The lesson has a 풀이 나누기 (discuss) phase of 10 minutes or more that names at least one student-to-student talk move (짝과 비교하기, 생각-짝-나누기, 친구 풀이 다시 말하기, 동의·반대) and gives prompts grounded in this problem's numbers and structure. Fail = under 10 minutes, only teacher-to-class questioning, or generic prompts.
Notes: Carried from upstream P-M3. Source: math.md 수업 흐름.

Criterion: Problem set covers the standard's structural cases
What pass requires: First enumerate the standard's structural cases yourself (baseline to hardest). Then verify each appears as a numbered required problem or the exit ticket, with its case named in the teacher facet; no required case is only in prose or an optional extension. List the enumeration and where each case appears.
Notes: Carried from upstream P-M4. Source: math.md 문제 세트.

Criterion: Exit ticket discriminates the primary misconception
What pass requires: The exit ticket is the hardest enumerated case and a student holding the lesson's primary anticipated misconception would answer it wrong; the teacher facet names the case. Its answer and every answer key in the package are correct when worked. Fail = an affirming instance the misconception still gets right, or any incorrect key.
Notes: Upstream exit-ticket guidance promoted to a criterion. Source: math.md 정리 문항 지침.

What pass requires: 초1–2: 구체물 or a drawn model is present in 스스로 해결하기 and add/subtract story-problem sets include a start- or change-unknown problem. 초3–4: 풀이 나누기 moves between at least two representations (구체물 → 그림 → 식). 초5–6: at least one task asks for a written explanation of a method's validity. Fail = the band's requirement is absent.
Notes: Replaces upstream K-2/3-5 branch notes, re-cut to Korean 학년군. Source: math.md 학년군 분기.

Criterion: Standard's full numerical scope is used
What pass requires: If the standard names fractions or decimals, at least one required problem uses them; if it names a range (네 자리 수, 받아올림이 있는), problems span it. Pass = numerical scope matches the standard. Fail = only small whole numbers where the standard requires more.

Computation, drawing, and model-building tasks get open space (answer_box ruled: false or the renderer's math default); only tasks asking for composed sentences get ruled lines. Fail = ruled handwriting lines under a task whose work is drawing or calculation.
Notes: Carried from upstream O-M1. The renderer now detects shared.subject '수학' and defaults to open space for 초1–5.
